notes.title: Post-Launch Update: A Rough First Week
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Queens and Kings of Davern,[/h3]
Last week, we launched a game you’d been looking forward to for a long time and it didn’t deliver. The game contained multiple blockers, froze frequently, and wasn’t in a playable state for many.

We messed up. We’re sorry, and we take full responsibility.

[h3]What happened?[/h3]
We were too ambitious and stretched our team too thin. We tried to create interwoven quests with branching paths and dynamic outcomes for both agents and the family, but it was more than our small team of four could handle.

[b]Did you not test your own game?[/b]
We did - extensively. We had multiple QA testers, ran several public demos, a Steam beta, and even showcased the game at Gamescom. But the reality is: no amount of internal or closed testing can match the creativity and unpredictability of thousands of real players. That doesn’t make it okay. We should have found a way to fix the bugs or made a smaller game, with less branching, better suited to our team size.

[h3]Where are we now and what’s next?[/h3]
As of today, we’ve fixed around 99% of all game-breaking bugs. The game is now stable for the vast majority of players. Could something obscure - something that hasn’t happened to thousands of players - still slip through? Yes. But if it does, we’ll be here to fix it. We’re not going anywhere.

We’ll continue fixing what’s left and improving the game over time. We have a list of small improvements we want to add, so we’re likely to keep updating the game in the months to come.

We listen to your feedback and do our best to make it a reality. If you have any thoughts, wishes, or requests, you can join our active Discord server or leave a thread on the Steam Discussions.

[b]On a positive note:[/b]
Since the major fixes, the game has been receiving a lot of very positive reviews. In the past two days, our average score has been 87%, confirming that  (once the issues are fixed) players are really enjoying what *Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall* has to offer.

[h3]Thank you <3[/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who’s been supportive over the past week. Your words of encouragement, trust, and love for the game are the reason we keep doing this.

[b]If you’ve enjoyed the game despite the rocky start, we’d be deeply grateful if you’d consider leaving us a review on Steam.[/b]

If you’re still experiencing issues, please make sure you’ve downloaded the latest build and read our patch notes. Some bugs were unfortunately “saved” in your most recent save and may require replaying from a previous week. In any case, you can always reach us on Discord and we can help there.

Thank you for your patience, understanding and sticking with us.
Brave Team.

notes.title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Release Date Delay
notes.notes:
[h3]We have some important news regarding Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall Release Date[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/72cedbc151d063132983ce5b484e0a7b88bcec26.png[/img]



---


Since announcing Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall at Summer Game Fest last year we have been flooded with positive comments and excitement about the game. We are just as excited for you to get your hands on the game but we have some important news to share with you regarding our release date.

Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall won’t make our 2024 release goal and we are moving the launch date to Q1 2025.

This game is extremely special to us and we want to make sure we deliver something that will stay in your memory for a very long time after you’ve played it. As you might already know, the sequel has been rebuilt from scratch to allow us to improve the visuals, management mechanics, queue system, story system etc. and whilst these improvements have undeniably made the game miles better, we still have a way to go to make it into a game we’ll be proud to ship.

We are really looking forward to sharing more about the game soon, so keep an eye on our channels in the next few weeks for updates.

Thank you so much to all of you have have shown us support since announcement, we see you <3 

Stay Brave,

Alina & Rafal

notes.title: Development Update #2 - Are we switching engines?
notes.notes:
A very exciting progress update on Snowfall this month! Read on to get a little sneak peak of some new animations, concept art and plans for the future!

As our team prepares for the Autumn months and we work comfortably wrapped in cosy blankets, we are getting ready to release a Beta build for all of you to try very soon. Keep an eye on the news here for updates! The Beta version will allow you to play through the first hour of the game, featuring random queue quests, new characters and our brand new management mechanics. We're excited to hear your feedback on these new systems! <3

In the past month we have organised a little field trip to the castle that inspired it all - Malbork castle in Gdansk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/994d2885b582141852f5d500ec24872f01e762a5.jpg[/img]

We have gathered some interesting textures, stories and historical facts to help us make the game even more interesting! - Did you know the castle, built in 1400s, had underfloor heating?!


In the meantime, the team has been diligently working on a chapter system. Have been writing captivating main storyline dialogues for chapter III, and also putting a lot of effort effort towards creating numerous new animations that will enhance the overall visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0808ddcd3af5f7e10b566f88f9e813149244afcd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/0fb4f15748b5861231dd00b0a259c61779d77bfd.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/c08db1174a8008f6b03c3ed9589aa41aabbef7c8.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21f32cd0b73f719eda60cb0c5a7389823a3376b4.gif[/img]

We also have some lovely concept art pieces for new scenes and some that are already in game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/21d7f499c7e4147ab0b659e9c345b7738c0e6b09.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/87d9e4ee9014a0c007a476181f7e22055e7d429f.jpg[/img]

I'm thrilled to share that the development of the game is going at a fantastic pace right now, and I couldn't be happier to inform you that we are not only meeting but also surpassing all of our milestones and marketing goals. We've been making remarkable progress, and I'm excited to announce that next month is going to be jam-packed with exciting updates. Get ready for new reveals, a fresh and revamped UI, and an epic new trailer that will surely blow you away!

[h2]Unity, Unity, Unity🙄[/h2]

Game development never goes smoothly, and this time is no exception. We have encountered several challenges along the way. Recently, the game engine we use, Unity, announced significant changes to their pricing structure. In addition to the monthly fee, we may also have to pay additional fees based on the number of game installs after a certain threshold. This will have an impact on both Yes, Your Grace and Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall, especially if we decide to participate in subscription-based or charity programs on various platforms. These programs can greatly increase the number of game installs.

We have had numerous discussions in the studio this week, and while we are disappointed with Unity's decisions, we are too far into development to switch engines. Doing so would result in major release delays. We have dedicated years to building our own development workflows and tools around Unity, so this is not a decision we take lightly. However, for future projects, we are likely to explore different game engines.


If you haven’t already, add the game to your wishlist and if you are enjoying these development updates make sure to click that thumbs up button <3



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373090/Yes_Your_Grace_Snowfall/

[h1]Welcome all Queens, Kings and Monarchs 👑[/h1]

The love and excitement we have been receiving from you folks in the past couple of months has been incredible 😍 It’s honestly so rewarding and motivating to see so many of you awaiting the sequel patiently, we’re trying our best to make it the best sequel you’ve played.

We wanted to share a small development writeup to keep you folks updated.

Firstly - we have reached a BIG milestone of writing the entire overarching storyline from start to finish, which means we now know what will be happening to each major character. Check out this sneak peak:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/262b524c3f41c10ed6975fb215411a1a85a428a3.png[/img]

------

We have spent a lot of time nailing down management design for the game and we think you’re going to love it! We have focused on making it very approachable and easy to understand, but it will have a ton of depth. We’ll talk some more about the design soon, but in the meantime here is a little behind the scenes on how the prototype design process looked like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/ae8c44af5460efa2e2a8fcac7f2c50b205eaa5fa.jpg[/img]

Our team is fully remote, which means we couldn't all be in one place to play the prototype, but we found a way:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224629/628ca79a139dd72ed5f1bdabbdb3e910cc7ee9fc.jpg[/img]


Lastly, our team grew 😲 we have welcomed two new team members this month, Leigh, who will bring you to tears with her magnificent dialogue writing skills and Natalia who helps to keep our chaotic team in check. 

While we’re working hard, we’d love to hear from you - what are you looking forward to the most? Seeing character stories, resource management or something else? Do you have any feature requests? Now would be the time to share those, we’re here to listen ❤️

Don’t forget this week is No More Robots anniversary sale, they have a ton of very cool games and they are all on sale - check those out here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nmr2023

One last thing, Yes, Your Grace is on a very big sale this week, so if it’s still on your wishlist, now is the perfect time to grab it at a bargain!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1115690/Yes_Your_Grace/
